import { home, updates as allUpdates } from '../content'
import type { Feature, Update } from '../content'
import { ImageSlot } from '../components/ImageSlot'
import { Empty, ErrorState, Loading } from '../components/States'
import { Link } from '../lib/router'
import { useAsync } from '../lib/useAsync'

/**
 * Where the updates come from. They are in content.ts now; to load them from somewhere else later (a file, or an API
 * through the site's own server function, never with a secret key in the page), change only this function.
 */
async function loadUpdates(): Promise<Update[]> {
  return allUpdates
}

const ICONS: Record<Feature['icon'], string> = {
  spark: 'M12 3v4M12 17v4M3 12h4M17 12h4M6 6l2.5 2.5M15.5 15.5L18 18M6 18l2.5-2.5M15.5 8.5L18 6',
  heart: 'M12 20s-7-4.4-7-10a4 4 0 0 1 7-2.6A4 4 0 0 1 19 10c0 5.6-7 10-7 10z',
  clock: 'M12 7v5l3 2M21 12a9 9 0 1 1-18 0 9 9 0 0 1 18 0z',
}

function Updates() {
  const state = useAsync(loadUpdates)
  if (state.status === 'loading') return <Loading label="Loading updates…" />
  if (state.status === 'error') return <ErrorState message={state.message} onRetry={state.retry} />
  if (state.data.length === 0) return <Empty title={home.updatesEmpty} />
  return (
    <ul className="updates" aria-label={home.updatesTitle}>
      {state.data.map((u) => (
        <li key={u.id} className="card update">
          {/* A date in content.ts is a calendar day: read in UTC, it shows the same day everywhere. */}
          <time className="update__date" dateTime={u.date}>
            {new Date(u.date).toLocaleDateString(undefined, {
              day: 'numeric',
              month: 'long',
              year: 'numeric',
              timeZone: 'UTC',
            })}
          </time>
          <h3 className="update__title">{u.title}</h3>
          <p>{u.text}</p>
        </li>
      ))}
    </ul>
  )
}

export function Home() {
  return (
    <>
      <section className="hero">
        <div className="container hero__inner">
          <div className="hero__text">
            <p className="eyebrow">{home.eyebrow}</p>
            <h1>{home.title}</h1>
            <p className="lead">{home.lead}</p>
            <div className="actions">
              <Link to={home.primaryAction.to} className="button">
                {home.primaryAction.label}
              </Link>
              <Link to={home.secondaryAction.to} className="button button--secondary">
                {home.secondaryAction.label}
              </Link>
            </div>
          </div>
          <ImageSlot label="Main picture for the home page" file="hero.jpg" size={[1200, 900]} />
        </div>
      </section>

      <section className="section" aria-labelledby="features-title">
        <div className="container">
          <h2 id="features-title">{home.featuresTitle}</h2>
          <ul className="grid">
            {home.features.map((f) => (
              <li key={f.title} className="card feature">
                <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true" className="feature__icon">
                  <path d={ICONS[f.icon]} fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.8" strokeLinecap="round" />
                </svg>
                <h3>{f.title}</h3>
                <p>{f.text}</p>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        </div>
      </section>

      <section className="section section--alt" aria-labelledby="updates-title">
        <div className="container">
          <h2 id="updates-title">{home.updatesTitle}</h2>
          <Updates />
        </div>
      </section>
    </>
  )
}
